params.name: appendTestSteps
params.description: By default, For Test Case(s) test steps are not included in the response. Specify appendTestSteps=true to include them.

params.name: includeExternalProperties
params.description: By default, For Requirement(s) external properties are not included in the response. Specify includeExternalProperties=true to include them.

params.name: includeTestLogProperties
params.description: By default, For Test Log(s) properties and Test step logs are not included in the response. Specify expandTestLogProperties=true to include them.
